All 9 tests now pass (`node --test`). I changed two source lines and left the tests alone.

**Bugs**
1. **`src/bill.js`, off-by-one in `splitBill`:** the check `i <= leftover` gave an extra cent to one payer too many. For example, `splitBill(900, 3)` returned `[301, 300, 300]`, so the total no longer matched. It is now `i < leftover`. This fixed the "even split", "leftover cents" and "total is preserved" tests.
2. **`src/duration.js`, incomplete validation in `parseDuration`:** it only threw when no `\d+[hms]` match was found anywhere in the input. A string like `"10m and change"` contained one match, so it was accepted and returned 600. It now throws unless the whole string is one or more `<digits><unit>` pairs, using `/^(\d+[hms])+$/`. `"3d"` and `"soon"` still throw as before.

I made the edits myself without delegating, since they were small.

The stricter check also rejects input with spaces, such as `"1h 30m"`. No test covers that case, so say if you want spaces allowed.
